id.description: The account's numeric id (gh api users/<login> --jq .id). When given, both must match: a login can be renamed and taken by someone else; the id cannot.

integration.description: trunk: rebase onto the default branch and push there, no PR. github-flow: push the branch and open a PR; the autonomy label decides who merges.

testCommand.description: The one command that proves the repo is green. verify.mjs runs it in HEAD's tree and records the result for that tree and that command; git's pre-push judge checks the record for the tree each push sends.

protectedPaths.description: Paths that make a change agent-needs-go. Entries are prefixes ("db/", "server/src/auth") or globs ("**/package.json"). A push touching one needs an approver's "go" recorded by approve.mjs. .sdlc-harness/ is always protected.

e2eTriggerPaths.description: Prefixes or globs. If the diff touches one, /ship runs e2eCommand after the push.

e2eCommand.description: On-demand end-to-end check, e.g. "gh workflow run e2e.yml". Optional.

browserVerify.description: The repo has a UI; /build verifies visible changes in a browser and attaches a screenshot to the issue.

requireGreen.description: Git's pre-push judge refuses a push whose tree sent has no green record. Set false only for repos with no tests yet.

issuePrefix.description: Commits name the issue as <prefix>-<number>. GH is GitHub's own autolink for issues in the same repo. The judge looks for this prefix to find a recorded go.

approvers.description: The only accounts whose comments approve an issue for work, give a push go, or accept it. Never the agent account.

agent.description: The GitHub account the agent writes through (a machine user or bot). Its `## Spec` comments are the Spec; its comments never approve.

people.description: Other humans who file issues. A refused issue they created goes back to them; one from anyone else goes to the first approver.

repo.description: owner/name of the repo whose Issues hold the work. Default: the GitHub repo origin names.

allowedOwners.description: GitHub accounts or orgs the agent may file issues and pull requests in. Default: the tracker repo's owner.

states.description: Where status is kept: status labels on the issue, or a single-select field on a Projects (v2) board.

owner.description: The org or user that owns the board.

area.description: The work area whose issues this repo's watch owns (decision 0007). A watching repo with no area runs no watch.

areas.description: Every area in the tracker, for setup-labels.mjs.

defaultArea.description: The area that owns an issue with no area label, a notification that is not about an issue, and an issue with several areas when it is among them.

inFlightLimit.description: Builds in flight at once, counted per area.

checkouts.description: owner/name of another repo → its checkout's path, relative to this repo's root, for issues this area owns whose change lands there.

watch.description: An interactive session in this repo claims the watch lock and runs the GitHub watch. Set false for a repo that should never watch, such as the handbook.

policyStart.description: Intake checks 2 and 3 apply to issues created on or after this date. Default: every issue.

modelLine.description: Every body the agent writes to GitHub ends with a line naming the model and version that wrote it.

subagentModel.description: The model every sub-agent runs with.

adhdStyle.description: Issue and PR text uses the ADHD style: answer first, numbered steps, short lists and lines.
